response.justification: Bogdan has deep technical breadth, strong open-source contributions, and leadership in project development, but lacks explicit experience in IT architecture design, UML modeling, and client-facing technical advisory roles, and his German proficiency is only basic — a critical gap given the C1 requirement.
strengths: Extensive open-source leadership with GISCollective and multiple DLang libraries
Proven full-stack expertise across languages, platforms, and DevOps tooling
Strong track record of mentoring and creating technical workshops/courses
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, not meeting C1 requirement
No clear evidence of UML, formal architecture design, or requirements management experience
Limited demonstration of client advisory or executive-level project oversight
